test_case.test_name: Variant-bound INA3221 and NCP45495 rail telemetry identity, scaling and range validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each specified INA3221 and NCP45495/OVRM monitor channel maps to the intended rail and reports correctly scaled voltage, current and power at the approved operating point within signed range, status and aggregation criteria.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and separation from aggregate PWR/PDB rows
Authoritative BMC SDR, Redfish or vendor read-only property IDs and decoder
Raw-to-unit formulas, units, operating load and timestamp/sampling requirements
Per-channel range/tolerance/status/aggregation oracle and optional calibrated-reference procedure
test_case.test_command: After target and variant confirmation, preserve baseline logs and operating state. Through the signed read-only interface, collect every mapped INA3221 and NCP45495 property without grep or truncation, including raw counts, converted voltage/current/power, units, status and timestamps. Correlate each value to the board rail/channel and approved load, calculate signed range and aggregation/reference comparisons, and leave thresholds, power state and registers unchanged.
test_case.expected_result: Every required monitor instance/channel is present at the approved identity, raw-to-unit conversion and rail mapping are correct, readings and status match signed limits at the documented operating point, derived power/aggregation agrees within tolerance, and no communication or hardware alarm occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when Source Key/Variant, complete chip/rail/channel map, raw and scaled values, units/status, operating point and signed range/tolerance or reference all match. Missing/stale/ambiguous channel, wrong scaling/unit/rail, out-of-range value, aggregation/reference mismatch or communication/hardware alarm is FAIL. Missing map or limits is BLOCKED at execution; PWR/PDB keyword matches cannot PASS this variant.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact platform/variant, read-only interface, chip/rail/channel/shunt map, scaling, operating point and oracle are signed.
Use secret-safe read-only BMC/Redfish/vendor access; never probe unknown registers or issue raw writes/threshold changes.
No load or power-state change unless separately authorized; preserve complete output and logs without truncation or clearing.
Stop on target mismatch, ambiguous/stale channel, unit/scaling error, out-of-range rail, communication failure or hardware alarm; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from rows 2028 PWR and 2274 PDB
Tool/firmware identity and complete raw property/SDR/sensor output
Per-channel raw counts, conversion formula, units/status and timestamped operating point
Signed range/tolerance plus aggregation or calibrated-reference comparison
Preserved BMC/SEL/host/power alarms, discrepancy/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Because collection is read-only, stop at the first identity, scaling, communication or alarm anomaly and preserve evidence. Leave thresholds, power and device registers unchanged; the power/platform owner diagnoses mapping or hardware state through the signed recovery process, without automatic retries or speculative raw access.
